notes.title: New Levels Added – Space Farming!
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

We’re excited to introduce new levels set in space! This update brings fresh challenges and unique alien fruits from another planet.

What’s New?
New space-themed levels
Strange, extraterrestrial crops to harvest
New space animals

Try them out and let us know what you think. More updates coming soon!

notes.title: New Keyboard Customization Options!
notes.content: Great news, farmers! 'Crop Chronicles' now lets you remap keyboard inputs for enhanced accessibility and comfort. Dive into the options menu to customize your controls and optimize your farming strategy. Enjoy the new flexibility and happy farming!

notes.title: New languages added to Crop Chronicles
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce an exciting update to our game!  You can now enjoy the game in English, Spanish, French, Portuguese (Brazil), and Simplified Chinese. 

This is just the beginning as we work towards making our game more accessible to players all around the world. If you have any questions, encounter any issues, or want to share feedback about the new languages, we’d love to hear from you. Your input helps us grow and improve!

notes.title: Patch 1.1
notes.content:
We have improved the compatibility with some computers where the video is not playing properly if they have some other software that interferes with video rendering.

Keep Farming :)

notes.title: Exciting News: Our Game Now Supports Apple Silicon Macs!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917373/66821684d2eb8961d1516d8a59d5f167617c30ae.jpg[/img]

Our latest update brings with it an exciting development—we've added support for Mac computers using Apple's powerful Silicon chips, including the M1, M2, and M3 processors. This enhancement ensures that players who prefer Apple's ecosystem can enjoy a seamless and optimized gaming experience.

By expanding our game's compatibility to include Apple Silicon Macs, we're excited to welcome more players into our growing community. This update not only enhances the game's accessibility but also ensures that everyone, regardless of their device choice, can have the best possible experience.

We're committed to continually improving Crop Chronicles, and support for Apple Silicon is just the beginning. Stay tuned for more updates and enhancements in the future!

As always, we thank you for your support and enthusiasm. Happy farming, and see you in the game!

notes.title: Our First Major Update Since the Latest Demo Release!
notes.content:
[h3]First up, the biggest change: a complete graphical rework![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917373/d0f3dec373d502d021a13f709935d3255e10d5aa.png[/img]

All in-game elements have been revamped with more vibrant colors and detailed visuals, giving the game a much more polished and professional look. While this update features a partial rework—since some assets are still in progress—the final version of the game will include the full overhaul.

[h3]The second exciting addition: Power-Ups![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44917373/c85f91ea90b3733c7e7a9b20aea7ab7de6c58d60.png[/img]

We’ve added 4 unique power-ups to make each playthrough more dynamic and fun:

Clock Power-Up: Freezes time for a few seconds, giving you extra time to rack up points.

Grow Power-Up: Instantly grows all your plants to their final phase, ready for harvest—no matter if they need water, fertilizer, or have pests!

Speed Power-Up: Grants a temporary speed boost so you can race across the map with ease.

Dog Power-Up: Stops all the animals in their tracks for a short period, so they won’t get in your way.

With these two big updates and several bug fixes, our demo feels more dynamic and alive than ever!

notes.title: 🚜 Introducing the "Crop Chronicles" Demo! 🌽
notes.content:
🌟 Demo Highlights:

[b]Dynamic Time-Management Gameplay:[/b] Race against the clock to manage farming, fishing, and strategizing across multiple levels.
[b]Explore and Expand:[/b] Unlock a wide range of crops and products, from dairy to juices, and even tackle beach levels!
[b]Challenging Mechanics:[/b] Master the essentials of farm management and efficient resource use.
🎮 [b]Experience It Now:[/b] Dive into the demo today and get a taste of the frenzy that awaits in the full game, set for release on November 15, 2024.

Join our community and follow the adventure that grows beyond just farming!
